title: Bell integrated into the saucer airframe in 1944

tellings.quote: They took the rockets out, put the bell in it, and there's your flying saucer.

plain: In 1944, at the Skoda Works, a big weapons factory near Prague, German engineers are said to have taken the rockets out of a disc-shaped aircraft and put in "the bell," a bell-shaped device said to be a secret Nazi power source, making a flying saucer. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells it in his own words, crediting a work called Closer Encounters: "They took the rockets out, put the bell in it, and there's your flying saucer." If true, it would mean Nazi Germany built a working saucer during the war.
